input.prompt: Use the supplied truck.jpg as the vehicle identity reference. Preserve its tall rounded high-roof cab-over silhouette, roof visor, broad dark windshield, paired vertical mirror housings, wide stacked grille with horizontal metal ribs, angular inset headlamps, stepped bumper, contoured doors, wheel arches, access steps and lower side fairing. Keep the two-axle tractor with single front tires and dual rear tires, coupled to the same three-axle trailer identity. Replace the photograph's blue body with satin Pegasoft carbon #11151B, adding one controlled Pegasoft blue #147DFF painted shoulder band around the rear door pillars and roof visor, plus a lower side-fairing and bumper return accent. Keep these exact physical accents coherent across the family. Use neutral brushed silver/titanium grille ribs, rims and fittings, natural matte black rubber, clear lightly cool-tinted glass with a single coherent interior, restrained #7BCBFF rim lighting and #B9E7FF pale practical reflections. Functional clear-white headlamps, amber indicators and red rear lamps only. Remove the source cargo box and its markings: show an empty full-length fixed 40-foot skeletal container chassis with two longitudinal load-bearing I-beams, crossmembers, four corner support/lock pads, fifth-wheel/kingpin connection, two stowed landing legs, side guards and three separate trailer axles. The chassis supports an existing 12.192 m long by 2.438 m wide container; use approximately 12.435 m frame length and approximately 1.35 m support-plane height as visual targets. The final supports will match the exact approved C01 model. Preserve realistic cab-to-trailer proportions, one tire/rim design and consistent axle counts. Remove Scania/manufacturer branding, insignia, registration, stripes and source text. Leave clean front grille and door label areas for external Pegasoft vector lettering. Render one complete vehicle on a transparent canvas with comfortable margins, cool even photographic studio lighting and crisp alpha edges. No cargo, people, scene, road, sky, sunset, warm decorative paint, logos, generated lettering, motion blur or baked shadow. Using the approved T01 image and the original truck.jpg as identity references, render the identical full vehicle in a strict straight-down orthographic upper view, nose to image right. Show the cab roof, the physical blue roof-band returns, mirrors, coupling, two chassis rails, crossmembers, four corner support pads and trailer wheel positions. The full chassis is empty and visible; do not invent a roof over it. No roof lettering, perspective tilt, underside, extra wheels or duplicated parts. All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.

recipe.note: These are the submitted inputs, not resolved server defaults. For a variation, copy them and change only requested fields; reuse returned_seed when supported by the schema. Source URLs may expire.

display_hint: Present completed media to the user. Forward attached image content blocks to the host's image display helper (for example, image(block)); do not stringify image blocks as text. For Markdown previews use previews[].preview_url, and separately link original_url as the full-resolution file. If no preview is available, show a clearly labeled original-file link. Do not claim a preview rendered unless it is visible. Video, audio and 3D URLs are original result files, not queue URLs.
